source_name: Upphandlingsmyndigheten — Nationella upphandlingsenkäten 2025, Effektiva offentliga inköp
population: Swedish public procurement organizations responding to national survey

observations.scope: self-reported organizations with full digital tender process from preparation through contract
self-reported organizations with full digital order-to-invoice process
self-reported organizations using AI fully or to a high degree in procurement and purchasing
self-reported organizations using AI not at all or to a low degree
self-reported organizations conducting market analyses before procurement fully or to a high degree
self-reported organizations conducting market analyses not at all or to a low degree
self-reported organizations following up supplier feedback on business relationship fully or to a high degree

limitations: Respondent self-report; not audited software usage or buyer payments.
Survey response rate approximately 31%; non-response and selection biases possible.
Different survey questions and denominators; do not subtract AI and digital process percentages to infer joint distribution.
No AgentMine buyers, contract revenue, willingness to pay, or attainable TAM verified.
decision_hypothesis: Buyer-side supplier discovery and pre-tender market analysis may be worth an opt-in workflow pilot, but requires independent workflow-time and paid-intent evidence; not a product-market-fit claim.
